properties.name: reflow2's served steps ask, in plain words, why the thing is being built, what could go wrong, and how the person will know it is good enough, and record the answers in the vocabulary reflow2 already has
properties.statement:
When a person starts or works a design, the served steps that talk to them (genesis and detect-and-ask) ask three plain questions that UAF's grid shows a complete design answers, and that reflow2 does not yet ask:
- WHY: what's pushing you to build this, and what would make it a success?
- WHAT COULD GO WRONG: what could go wrong, how likely is it, and how bad would it be?
- HOW YOU'LL KNOW: how will you know it's good enough?
The answers are recorded in the record types reflow2 already has (Requirements, Constraints, Decisions, Verifications), and NO new node type is added for them. Whether people answer these questions, and what they say, is measured before any vocabulary is proposed (req:functional-vocabulary-computes). The person is never shown the framework the questions come from.

@ajs, 2026-09-28, keeping option (g) of dec:idea-what-reflow2-takes-from-uaf-1-3 as intent ("Questions only (g)"), after UAF 1.3 was read against reflow2 (fact:uaf-1-3-read-against-reflow2-2026-09-28).
